title: Change one production variable at a time
summary: Community hypothesis: compare controlled prompt/settings alternatives and their generated audio before attributing a change in outcome to a particular instruction.

build.target: Run a cost-bounded comparison of one Suno production technique against a specified baseline.
requires: Same model, duration, generation mode and controls where possible
Authorized Suno credits and rights to source material
inputs: Predeclared comparison metric and candidate budget
outputs: Requests and clip IDs linked to experimental conditions
Blind listening results and any negative outcomes
execute: Write a hypothesis and one variable to change.
Hold model, controls, genre, lyrics, candidate counts and references fixed unless impossible; document confounds.
Obtain a credit budget and assign random IDs to treatments.
Generate at the authorized count, inspect audio and capture blind listener feedback.
Report observations, null findings, confounds and model-specific scope; do not generalize from one pair.

applies_when: Two prompt strategies compete and their comparative utility is uncertain.
A production technique might depend on model or vocal genre.
avoid_when: The provider prevents comparing conditions under the same model and this confound cannot be controlled.
No credit authorization or rights to the inputs.

operator: Fix a maximum number of clips and credit budget before operation.
No automatic paid retries or cherry-picked exclusion of poor generations.

stop_when: Budget exhausted, documented error, or predeclared candidate count reached.
Report inconclusive when comparisons are confounded.

checks: A/B receipts show model, settings and both conditions.
Human listener comparisons and failure counts are retained.
